items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Her name was Leona Bayham. She'd play the piano and I'd play the drums for her.

ctx.x: What did your brother play? He played drums.

What did you play? That started me playing music at the age of five. I started playing drums. In fact, he had two sets. And when he would leave Madison to go around Ibiza Spring, those places to play with Bung Johnson, he'd leave a set of drums at the Sons of Leobol in Madisonville where I think in those days it was showing silent pictures. He had a piano player while the pianola would play during the pitch and when the pitch was over, she would play the piano. Her name was Leona Bayham. She'd play the piano and…
And you remember anything about the band that Bung was in? Who was the band?
